'''Fudbalski klub Proleter Teslić''' ([[Serbian Cyrillic]]: Фудбалски клуб Пpoлeтep Tecлић) is a [[football (soccer)|football]] club from [[Teslić]], in [[Republika Srpska]], [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]]. They play in the second division of the Republika Srpska championship. Until 2007 Proleter was playing in the 2nd division, when they qualified for the first league after 11 years. The club plays its home matches on the Radolinka stadium .

Proleter was founded in 1926 and played mostly in lower Yugoslav leagues."}}
